ACCOUNT.TITLE: Account
ACCOUNT.DESCRIPTION: Sign-in and sync are coming soon.

STATUS.TITLE: Status
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: You're in guest mode. bibo saves all boards in this browser.

MENU.LOCAL_DESCRIPTION: Not synced to the cloud. Clearing browser data will delete your boards.

NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: Email and notifications
NOTIFICATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Choose when bibo notifies you. Coming soon.

DIGEST.TITLE: Activity digest email
DIGEST.DESCRIPTION: Get an email summary of changes on boards you're part of.

MENTION.TITLE: When someone mentions you
MENTION.DESCRIPTION: Get notified when someone mentions you in a note or comment.

INVITE.TITLE: When invited to a board
INVITE.DESCRIPTION: Get notified when someone shares a board with you.

NEWS.TITLE: Product news
NEWS.DESCRIPTION: Occasional emails about new bibo features.

APPEARANCE.TITLE: Appearance
APPEARANCE.DESCRIPTION: Customize how bibo looks. Saved in this browser.

STYLE.TITLE: Style
STYLE.HAND_HINT: Sketchy outlines with a hand-drawn feel.

SIZE.TITLE: Interface size
SIZE.PREVIEW_BODY: Collect scattered ideas, drag them into order and see the whole picture on a single board without losing a thing.

TOOLBAR.TITLE: Toolbar
TOOLBAR.DESCRIPTION: Choose which buttons appear on the canvas toolbar.

CANVAS.TITLE: Canvas
CANVAS.DESCRIPTION: Background grid and scrolling on the canvas. Saved in this browser.

GRID.TITLE: Background grid
GRID.DESCRIPTION: Show dots on the canvas background.

SCROLL_SPEED.TITLE: Scroll speed
SCROLL_SPEED.DESCRIPTION: How far the canvas moves per wheel step. {keys} + scroll zooms instead.

LOCALIZATION.TITLE: Language and region
LOCALIZATION.DESCRIPTION: Interface language and how dates are shown.

DATE_FORMAT.TITLE: Date format
DATE_FORMAT.DESCRIPTION: How dates are shown in the app.

WEEK_START.TITLE: First day of week
WEEK_START.DESCRIPTION: Used for calendars and date pickers.

KEYBOARD.TITLE: Keyboard type
KEYBOARD.DESCRIPTION: How shortcut keys are shown (⌘ or Ctrl) and which key to hold when clicking to add to a selection. Detected automatically; change it only if the app gets it wrong.

DATA.TITLE: Data
DATA.DESCRIPTION: Boards, objects and storage in use.

BOARDS.TITLE: Boards
BOARDS.DESCRIPTION: Number of boards, including Home and sub-boards.

OBJECTS.TITLE: Objects
OBJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Total notes, boards and other objects, including Unsort.

USAGE.TITLE: Storage
USAGE.DESCRIPTION: Estimated storage bibo uses in this browser.

BACKUP.TITLE: Backup
BACKUP.DESCRIPTION: Download all your boards. Coming soon.

SUBGROUP.LINE_START: At the start of a new line

ACTION.OPEN_BOARD: Open a board (double-click its color block)
ACTION.TOGGLE_SELECT: Add or remove an object from the selection
ACTION.MARQUEE: Select an area (drag on empty space)
ACTION.MARQUEE_ADD: Add an area to the selection
ACTION.CLIP_CUT: Move a paragraph into a new note (drag the card icon next to it)
ACTION.CLIP_COPY: Copy a paragraph into a new note, keep the original

UNSORT.TITLE: Unsort
UNSORT.HINT: Drag an item onto the canvas to place it.

HELP_MENU.TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION: Get to know bibo step by step

VIEW_POPUP.PRESENTATION_TIP: Go full screen and hide the toolbar, dot grid, and more.

EXPORT_POPUP.NO_FILES: No files found on this board

DELETE_MANY.DESCRIPTION: This will delete {items}. You can undo with {undo}.
